To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1. Activity recognition is a difficult task, but can be performed with reasonable accuracy.

(a) a simple majority voting classifier is able to achieve high accuracy in activity recognition from accelerometer data and (b) this simple majority voting classifier can be further enhanced with a simple majority voting meta-level classifier to achieve higher accuracy.

(1) the performance of base-level classifiers is not very sensitive to the feature representation, (2) the performance of the base-level classifiers is sensitive to the choice of the classifier, (3) meta-level classifiers perform consistently well across all settings, (4) the performance of meta-level classifiers is not sensitive to the choice or the number of base-level classifiers, and (5) the performance of a meta-level classifier is not sensitive to feature representation
